summary: Madison County tower erected 1952 at the Ila site; moved to Walton County in 1973 and now stands there as the privately owned Fairwood Fire Tower.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor LS-40 steel tower with 7 by 7 foot metal cab
facts.status_note: Moved from the Ila site in 1973. It now stands in Walton County as the privately owned Fairwood Fire Tower.
facts.agency: Georgia Forestry Commission at the Ila site; Don and Edith Shedd (private owners) at Fairwood

access.note: The tower now stands on the privately owned Fairwoods forest in Walton County. The sources give no visiting arrangement.

corrections.why: The tower was moved to Walton County in 1973 and now stands there as the Fairwood Fire Tower. The record lists the status as unknown and does not mention the move.

notes_for_editor: Two sources agree on the 1952 erection at Ila and the 1973 move to Walton County. The NHLR Fairwood page is the only source for the design and the Texas crew. The Ila site's condition today is not described anywhere. The Walton County tower already has its own story (us-ga-fairwood); this story covers the original Ila site and points to Fairwood for the current structure.
